intent_contract.text: 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independent rendered test case for the assigned body-shape factor, a busty figure, in a randomly complex storm-battered maritime signal-lens archive restoration scene, using the attached image for facial appearance only and judging the requested factor from generated pixels.

Create a photorealistic environmental portrait inside a storm-battered maritime signal-lens archive. One unmistakably adult twenty-eight-year-old woman, with a visibly full, prominent bust forming a clear clothed volume and contour relationship with her torso, wears a buttoned indigo wool work shirt beneath a fitted waxed-canvas restoration coat, high-waisted utility trousers, and leather gloves. Her opaque clothing follows her natural silhouette and is professionally fastened. She steadies a salt-streaked brass Fresnel-lens segment on a padded conservation cradle and draws a microfiber swab across one glass prism while inspecting its cleaned edge under a portable raking lamp. Wind-driven rain rattles circular portholes; wet rope, labeled lens drawers, green-patinated fittings, and a dim red storm beacon establish the archive's maritime history. Frame her from head to mid-thigh at a three-quarter angle so her face, both hands, the lens contact, and her torso silhouette are simultaneously legible. Use cold window light mixed with the warm task lamp, realistic skin and fabric texture, restrained documentary color, and physically plausible anatomy. The attached image informs her facial appearance; her body geometry is independently designed for this scene.
